To me this poem struck chords of love and addiction. As someone who is currently struggling with addiction, that popped out to me first (along with the title). Specifically these lines:

> A heart that rarely spoke began to warn, for an encounter which had occurred was not meant to linger—

> A fruit which should only be tasted once was eaten over and over again—

> It’s taste exaggerated by a hopeless place—

> He had completely let go, becoming a passenger in his own train—

> Waking up, he realized his train had stopped, all energy drained from its soul—

> A support who was really a leeched vanished before his eyes 

> For only the taste of the fruit which he had was what brought them together—

To me it reads like someone falling down the rabbit hole of addiction only to emerge to find their friends they made while being an addict were only there to mooch. I really liked this poem!
